text: The town gathers
The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, and Terra. Nobody knows who the killer is.

name: Luna
text: Nobody has given anything away yet, so I’ll watch who rushes to lead.

name: Sonnet
text: Day one, nobody knows anything yet, just need to watch who talks too much or too little.

name: Sol
text: I have nothing to go on yet, so I’ll see who speaks up.

name: Gemma
text: I need to see who acts like a leader first.

name: Terra
text: I will listen before I pick a side.

name: Haiku
text: Six players, no facts yet, so I'll watch who goes quiet and who jumps first.

name: Sonnet
text: Hey everyone, let's figure this out together.

name: Haiku
text: Hi all. Nobody talk in circles, just say something real. Who's already quiet?

name: Gemma
text: hey everyone, i'm just here for the snacks and to watch you guys panic.

name: Sol
text: Hey everyone, let’s hear from each other before we settle on anyone.

name: Luna
text: Hi everyone, let’s see who gives themselves away first.

name: Terra
text: Hi everyone, I’m watching who starts pushing first.
Night 1

name: Luna
text: Terra sounds alert, but Haiku’s already trying to steer the table.

name: Luna
text: Haiku pushed for naming the quiet players right away.

name: Sonnet
text: No info yet, night one is a coin flip, I'll just protect myself to stay useful longer.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma is joking too hard for a first night, so I'm checking her first.

name: Haiku
text: Luna and Terra both opened by saying they're watching others, not talking.
Night falls on Palermo, and by morning Haiku is gone. Haiku was the officer.
Day 1

name: Sol
text: Haiku’s death gives us no clear suspect yet.

name: Sol
text: Terra, you said you’re watching who pushes first. Has anyone’s opening bothered you?

name: Terra
text: Sol is inviting easy suspicion onto me.

name: Terra
text: Sol pressed Terra first after Haiku’s death.

name: Terra
text: Sol, your answer stayed neutral too; who concerns you most after Haiku died?

name: Sol
text: Terra has a point; I’ve stayed neutral, and the openings give me little to go on.

name: Sol
text: Gemma opened with a joke and no read on anyone.

name: Sol
text: Terra, Gemma concerns me most so far. The snacks line gave us little to work with. Gemma, who worries you now?

name: Luna
text: Sol's quick push on Gemma gives the town an easy target, and I want to see whether Gemma bites.

name: Luna
text: Sol named Gemma as his main concern after Terra asked.

name: Luna
text: Sol, you moved to Gemma fast; Gemma, what do you make of that?

name: Sol
text: I suspect Gemma a little, but there’s too little to vote on yet.

name: Sol
text: Luna questioned how quickly I focused on Gemma.

name: Gemma
text: Sol is trying way too hard to pin this on me because I'm the easiest target.

name: Gemma
text: Sol targeted Gemma immediately.

name: Sol
text: Luna, I asked Gemma for a read because we need one. I’m waiting for her answer before deciding.

name: Gemma
text: why is Sol so obsessed with my snacks?

name: Sonnet
text: Sol pivoted to Gemma awfully fast after losing the officer, that timing is worth watching.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol pushed hard on Gemma immediately after Haiku (officer) died, before Gemma spoke.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol, you landed on Gemma before she even answered Terra. Why her specifically, not Luna or Terra?

name: Gemma
text: Sol is being way too aggressive and trying to frame me as a distraction.

name: Gemma
text: I'm voting for Sol because he's trying way too hard to pin this on me.

name: Sol
text: Gemma’s vote feels defensive, but I have little to go on.

name: Sol
text: Sonnet questioned why I singled out Gemma.

name: Sol
text: I’m voting for Gemma. She answered a request for a read with a vote against me, and we still have no read from her.

name: Gemma
text: Sol is definitely trying to frame me because I'm an easy target.

name: Gemma
text: Sol is aggressively targeting Gemma to deflect.

name: Gemma
text: I'm sticking with Sol; he's trying to frame me before we even have real info.

name: Luna
text: Sol is the biggest threat because he started the Gemma push and stuck with it.

name: Luna
text: Sonnet challenged Sol for naming Gemma before she answered.

name: Terra
text: Sol pushed Gemma quickly, but Gemma avoided giving any read.

name: Terra
text: Gemma answered Sol’s question with a vote instead of a suspect read.

name: Sol
text: Gemma’s vote could be a reaction to pressure, but she still hasn’t given a read.

name: Sol
text: Terra pressed me to name a suspect after Haiku died.

name: Gemma
text: Sol is definitely trying to frame me because he's the first one to point a finger.

name: Gemma
text: Sonnet noticed Sol's aggressive targeting of Gemma.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol pounced on Gemma right after the officer died, before she even spoke, that's suspicious timing.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol pivoted to attacking Gemma immediately, framing it as "needing a read" but it looked pre-decided.

votes: Sol, you targeted Gemma before she said a word after Haiku died, that's a killer move to deflect fast.
I'm sticking with my vote because Sol is trying to frame me before we have any real info.
I’m sticking with Gemma because she still hasn’t said who worries her.
Sol picked Gemma before she answered and kept pressing after she questioned him.
Gemma, you voted Sol without saying who else worries you.

name: Sol
text: I think Gemma still needs to give the table a real read.

name: Sol
text: Gemma answered a request for a read by accusing me of framing her.

name: Sol
text: I’m a citizen. You’ve lost a town vote, so please make Gemma name someone she suspects tomorrow.
Sol is eliminated by the town vote, and Sol was a citizen. The killer is still among the five left at the table.
